title: About Neeta
bio: I create visuals that connect culture with modern audiences. My practice blends traditional motifs, illustration, photography, and digital systems to tell human stories.
long: Neeta Bhusal is a multidisciplinary creator based in Kathmandu. Her work blends Madhubani and folk motifs with contemporary digital design — resulting in vibrant posters, identities, and photographic series that bridge tradition and modernity.
